title: Forms UI: field widgets and Fill & Sign
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-25 and O-05 work on a real form fixture in all four theme/control combinations
notes: Shell half of the forms pair per ADR 0012; opens only after the T-0234 library is verified and its claim is released. Serves acceptance items A-25 (Fill & Sign: fill form fields) and O-05 (fill, tab order, save with appearances, FDF/XFDF, flatten) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Draws field widgets over the page at the library-provided field rectangles, wires tab order, apply and reset, reads and writes XFDF through the T-0234 API, and shows the Fill & Sign tool row only when the capability is on. Calls the library and does not change its semantics. The FORMS feature-matrix rows become `verified` only when this task lands; until then they stay `library` after T-0234. The app lane runs one task at a time, so earlier app tasks are implicit ordering constraints, not formal dependencies.
